item.title: How We Built TLX: A Hardware-Native GPU Compiler for Production ML at Scale
item.content:encoded:
Triton Low-Level Extensions (TLX), is an extension to Triton that helps engineers optimize GPU performance while preserving Triton’s productive programming model.  TLX introduces explicit warp-group and cluster-level orchestration, letting developers adopt new hardware capabilities without sacrificing velocity.  TLX has demonstrated performance improvements in RecSys training, RecSys inference, and large-scale LLM pretraining. item.title: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs
item.content:encoded:
We built a vendor-neutral accelerator plugin architecture in lldb-server for debugging applications that span CPUs and GPUs. It separates shared debugger infrastructure from hardware-specific device control. The design represents the CPU and GPU as separate debugger processes while presenting them in one debugging session.
